activity_summary: At the Jackdaw, before you read, the foul sheets hold the Worthies without their names, the messenger, the half-line still blank, and the women's year. The objection is not written yet. There is no song and no last line. Burbage has not heard the act.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Opened the sheets and did not fill the line.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Not yet hearing it. Named as the man the pages are for.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The fifth act, as far as it goes
